content:
alex: Pushing for final signoffs — compact draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/final-draft-v4. Two quick asks: benchmark language check and the CTA + HubSpot wiring snippet for ops. Can we finish today?

marta: On it. I'll tighten the hero and remove extraneous superlatives. Also move the demo assignment rules into the FAQ.

sam: Benchmark copy proposal: "On a mixed chat + long-context streaming workload (avg conv length ~650 tokens), Redwood reduced per-token compute by approximately 25-30% vs baseline (see run run_2026_03_28_v4, s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/28/run_v4/metrics.csv)." Leaving it as a range for legal comfort.

alex: Good. Kasia/legal please confirm wording.

kasia: I can approve the range if the CSV link is inserted and a one-line methodology note is added (what baseline is, hardware parity). Also need the claim sign-off checklist completed in the doc.

jenni: Webinar details to include in the post: Tue 2026-04-06 09:00 PT, cap 220, ops reserved 50 demo seats. Demand gen asks: enterprise leads get 2 demo seats priority for the first 48 hours; after that they drop to 1. Need this spelled out under CTA microcopy and in FAQ.

oliver: Ops can implement that. Please paste HubSpot mapping so I can run a webhook test and pre-provision seats.

sam: HubSpot snippet to paste under Integration appendix: ```hubspot_form_id: hs_105577; properties: email->contact.email, company->contact.company, lead_tier->single_select(enterprise,startup,other); campaign: product_launch_apr2026; webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/announce-2026```

ops-bot: automated-check: webhook endpoint responds 200 to test payload.

kasia: Legal microcopy requests: CTA claim line and a short data-residency sentence. Draft CTA: "Register to see the product in action and request a demo." Data residency: "EU leads are routed to our EU HubSpot instance; contact data retained for 18 months (subject to Privacy confirmation)."

legal-bot: scan: email and company only; flag: retention period requires Privacy confirmation.

marta: Editorial microflow under hero: 1) Register 2) Confirm by email 3) Request demo (optional). And under CTA: short note: "Demo seats limited; assignment prioritized for enterprise leads in first 48h."

alex: Approvals timeline: editorial & ops by today EOD, legal + privacy by tomorrow noon, schedule publish Tue morning. Everyone ack so we can lock?

sam: Ack — will insert CSV link and the one-line methodology.

jenni: Ack — will confirm webinar attendee counts and dry-run timing.

oliver: Ack — will run webhook + seat-assignment test and paste trace by EOD. Seat allocation pseudo: ```if lead_tier=='enterprise' and publish_age_hours<48: seats=2 elif lead_tier=='enterprise': seats=1 elif lead_tier=='startup': seats=1 else: seats=0```

kasia: Ack — will fill claim sign-off checklist and chase Privacy for retention confirmation.

alex: Thanks all. I'll lock the doc after legal greenlights the claim language. Ping here with the final snippets and I'll queue for publish review. :thumbsup:
